tha-ap400:1.1: Salaḷamaṇḍapiya.] Nibbute Kakusandhamhi brāhmaṇamhi vusīmati / gahetvā salaḷaṃ mālaṃ maṇḍapaṃ kārayim ahaṃ. // //
tha-ap400:2.1: Tāvatiṃsagato santo labhāmi vyamham uttamaṃ / aññe deve 'tirocāmi puññakammass' idaṃ phalaṃ. // //
tha-ap400:3.1: Divā vā yadi vā rattiṃ caṅkamanto ṭhito c'ahaṃ / channo salaḷapupphehi puññakammass' idaṃ phalaṃ. // //
tha-ap400:4.1: Imasmiṃ yeva kappamhi yaṃ Buddham abhipūjayiṃ / duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi Buddhapūjāy' idaṃ phalaṃ.
tha-ap400:8.1: Itthaṃ sudam āyasmā Salaḷamaṇḍapiyo thero i. g. a-ti. /
